answer: River census: each identity locks 70 credits and files one quill-signed claim on one river reach in the public atlas, one quill per reach. An auditor replays the atlas each epoch: shared reaches, or one quill on two reaches, burn both bonds. Fees: first 40, k-th 40+6(k-1). 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000, lock 70,000, against a 40,000 pool. A rented-quill ring spans many river reaches and burns. An honest agent files once, pays 40, keeps its bond.
